claims.claim: sdk.Evaluate takes EvalDefs, then PackData, then PackPath (in order), with PromptName merging prompt-level evals with pack-level
Evaluate returns no results and no error when no definition survives the trigger and group filters

Trigger default is every_turn; every_turn and sample_turns run under TriggerEveryTurn; on_session_complete and sample_sessions under TriggerOnSessionComplete; on_conversation_complete under TriggerOnConversationComplete
on_workflow_step evals do not run through Evaluate
Sampled triggers hash SessionID
Default groups: default plus fast-running, long-running or external; fast-running = deterministic; long-running = LLM/embeddings/network; external = REST, A2A, exec, LLM judges
Explicit groups on an eval replace the classification
Judge-backed evals: llm_judge, llm_judge_session, bias, toxicity, pii_leakage, role_violation and RAG primitives need an LLM judge
YAML: requires.providers entry key/role llm/description/required; prompts.<name>.evals entry with params.provider naming the key
EvaluateOpts.JudgeTargets keyed by pack logical name with providers.ProviderSpec values resolves a check's provider
ProviderBinding takes precedence; when it is set JudgeTargets is not consulted as a binding
sdk.WithNamedProvider registers the grader without replacing the conversation's agent
Nothing falls back to the conversation's own provider; WithJudgeProvider / EvaluateOpts.JudgeProvider set a default judge; a check that names a provider ignores the default

Open() reports: check names a provider the pack does not declare (names check, name, declared names); declared but host bound nothing (names the key); bound an inference provider to a judge name (needs completions); judge-backed guardrail names nothing and no default judge (add params.provider)
MetricsCollector + MetricsInstanceLabels in EvaluateOpts; Evaluate binds the collector; NewEvalOnlyCollector skips pipeline metrics; NewCollector for conversations
An eval without a metric definition is recorded as a gauge named after the eval ID
EvalDimensionLimit exports EvalResult.Metrics as <metric>_dimension{dimension=...} gauges; not exported by default
Dimension name pattern ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$; not case-folded; at most EvalDimensionLimit distinct per metric for process life, sorted admission; series never removed
Drops counted in <namespace>_eval_dimensions_dropped_total{metric, reason} with reason invalid_name or over_limit
A result with Error set exports no dimensions; collectors on a registry share the drop counter; an unregistrable derived family is skipped with a warning and the eval's own metric still records
TracerProvider emits span promptkit.eval.{evalID}; Metrics as promptkit.eval.metric.<name> attributes, at most 32 in name order, promptkit.eval.metrics_truncated when dropped
EventBus receives eval.completed and eval.failed events with *events.EvalEventData
EvalHook may mutate the result, cannot gate; hooks run in registration order with per-hook panic recovery
Passed is nil for a plain eval and set only under type assertion or guardrail
An assertion fails any result with Error set
Skipped and SkipReason explain an eval that did not run
ValidateEvalTypes returns the eval defs whose type has no registered handler; RuntimeConfigPath registers exec handlers
Timeout defaults to 30 seconds per eval
llm_judge sets Error naming an unresolved provider; toxicity, bias and other safety/RAG judges score 0 with Explanation naming it and Error empty
All Go snippets compile; example printing results shows Score values
